unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). '......' cells (legend: '... No Transactions') are omitted, not transcribed as 0. The Individual Income Taxes subrows publish gross receipts only. Superscript footnote marker 2 is visually attached to All Other current-FYTD gross receipts; the printed numeric value is 10,155, transcribed as 10155. Values otherwise appear exactly as printed, with thousands separators stripped.
